cells.gaps: No source found shows either law in regular use in the last two years; no use of Law 2026-20 is on record.
cells.note: The 2008 cybercrime law is in force and was used in a November 2024 conviction (SEN-005), so stage 4; Law 2026-20 on digital security, promulgated on 10 September 2026 and gazetted on 17 October 2026 (SEN-007), adds a second law in force. Stage 5 needs regular use, and two cases are on record at most.
